purpose: Execution profiles for skill loading, token budget, validation, and delegation.

fast.notes: Use for small edits, quick answers, and tasks where one skill clearly matches.

guided-engineering.notes: Use for non-trivial engineering work; select only the applicable architecture, backend, frontend, data, semantics, security, and testing capabilities.

deep.notes: Use for broad or difficult work that needs deeper single-agent reasoning. Select multiagent explicitly only when independent parallel lanes are justified.

multiagent.notes: Explicit fan-out profile. Use only when the user asks for multiagent/team/swarm/parallel work or the plan contains 2+ genuinely independent workstreams with non-overlapping ownership.

phase-loop.notes: Opt-in phase workflow. Phases remain single-agent by default; select multiagent separately when parallel lanes are explicitly justified.

saas.notes: Use for SaaS products and reviews. Remains single-agent by default; multiagent fan-out is a separate explicit routing decision.

security.notes: Use only for owned repos or authorized targets. Security depth does not imply multiagent fan-out; select multiagent separately when justified.
